item.title: Version 1.8.0
item.description:
The Lively Update

  • Perch in the menu bar
    Click the bird to show or hide the shelf, drop files on it, or find Settings and every shortcut. Hide it from its menu whenever you've got the hang of things.
  • ⌃ Control handles the shelf, ⌥ Option handles items
    Hold ⌃ Control at an edge to bring the shelf out, and Control-drag to move it. ⌥ Option-drag drags out a duplicate.
  • See what a key does before you use it
    Hold ⌃ Control, ⌥ Option, ⌘ Command or ⇧ Shift and the shelf shows what that key would do.
  • Triple-click to put it away
    A shelf holding your stuff tucks into its edge. An empty one just goes.
  • Every shortcut in one place
    Shortcuts… in the shelf's right-click menu or the menu bar lists everything Perch can do. Welcome Screen… brings back the tour anytime.
